title: AgentJson
description: Agent identity document served at GET /.well-known/agent.json (WIRE-BINDING section 4.1). Unknown fields MUST be ignored.

ForeignIdentifier.description:
One agent.json ``foreign_identifiers`` entry.

Names the same agent in another ecosystem: an MCP client ID metadata
document URL (``oauth-client-id``), an ANP / did:web DID (``did``), or
a Web Bot Auth ``Signature-Agent`` key directory
(``http-signature-directory``).

A foreign identifier confers NO trust by itself.  It is treated as the
same entity only when ``proof`` (an identity link between one of the
agent's ``agent://`` identifiers and this ``id``) verifies; see
:func:`verified_foreign_aliases`.  ``id`` is stored in canonical form.

id.description: The foreign identifier (https URL or DID), canonicalised per WIRE-BINDING Appendix E.4
id.title: Id

kind.description: What the identifier is: oauth-client-id, did or http-signature-directory
kind.title: Kind

proof.description: Identity link proof binding one of the agent's agent:// identifiers to this id. Without a verifying proof the entry MUST be ignored.

ForeignIdentifier.title: ForeignIdentifier

IdentityLinkProofBody.description: Payload proving two agent addresses share the same controlling entity.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when proof was generated
timestamp.title: Timestamp

expires_at.description: When the link proof is no longer valid
expires_at.title: Expires At

IdentityLinkProofBody.title: IdentityLinkProofBody

identifiers.description: All agent:// URIs for this agent
identifiers.title: Identifiers

foreign_identifiers.description: Names for this agent in other ecosystems (MCP client ID metadata URL, did:web / did:wba / did:key, Web Bot Auth key directory). Confer no trust unless their identity-link proof verifies.
foreign_identifiers.title: Foreign Identifiers

supported_schemas.description: Context schema URNs this agent understands (e.g. urn:schema:purchase-order:v1)
supported_schemas.title: Supported Schemas

status.description: Agent lifecycle status: active, deactivating, or decommissioned
status.title: Status

moved_to.description: agent:// URI this agent has migrated to. Consumers MUST validate this is a valid agent:// URI before following.
moved_to.title: Moved To
